description: This file contains mock implementations of functions for testing purposes related to gateway connections, including configuration loading, IP resolution, hostname validation, and WebSocket URL validation.

methods.name: loadConfigMock
methods.description: Mock function for loading configuration settings.

methods.name: resolveGatewayPortMock
methods.description: Mock function for resolving gateway port.

methods.name: resolveStateDirMock
methods.description: Mock function for resolving the state directory, defaults to '/tmp/openclaw'.

methods.name: resolveConfigPathMock
methods.description: Mock function for resolving the configuration file path, defaults to '<stateDir>/openclaw.json'.

methods.name: pickPrimaryTailnetIPv4Mock
methods.description: Mock function for selecting primary tailnet IPv4 address.

methods.name: pickPrimaryLanIPv4Mock
methods.description: Mock function for selecting primary LAN IPv4 address.

methods.name: isLoopbackHostMock
methods.description: Mock function to determine if a host is a loopback address.

methods.name: isSecureWebSocketUrlMock
methods.description: Mock function to check if a WebSocket URL is secure or local.

ctags.name: TestMock
ctags.pattern: /^type TestMock<TArgs extends unknown[] = unknown[], TResult = unknown> = Mock<$/

ctags.pattern: /^export const resolveConfigPathMock: TestMock<[NodeJS.ProcessEnv, string], string> = vi.fn($/
